title: Unions
explain: A union type, written with `|`, says a value can be one of several types. Literal types like `"red" | "green"` limit a value to exact strings. Together they replace many loose strings and flags with checked choices.
exercise: Create a `Direction` type for north, south, east and west, and a function that returns the opposite direction.
tip: A union only lets you use what every member has in common. To use anything more specific, narrow it first.
